assumptions.reason: In 15-minute regular trading hours data (09:30-16:00), the 15:45 bar represents the final 15-minute bar of the trading session.

assumptions.choice: Place market order on first 15-minute bar (09:30) so Backtrader executes it at the start of next bar (09:45)
assumptions.reason: In Backtrader, a market order placed in next() during the 09:30 bar fills at the 09:45 bar open, which represents entry at the close of the first 15-minute bar.
